headline: Easy early Alpha: Chillet
title: Easiest Early Alpha Pal in Palworld | Chillet Location | Palworld Guide
video_script: Looking for an easy first Alpha Pal in Palworld? Go for Chillet! This level eleven Alpha spawns really close to the starting area in the Windswept Hills, at around one seven three, minus four one eight. Catching it early gives you an Ice and Dragon Pal with strong attack for the early game. Weaken it, throw your spheres from behind, and it's yours. What was your first Alpha catch? Comment below!
description: Palworld 1.0 easy early Alpha: Chillet, level 11, near the starting area in the Windswept Hills at around (173, -418). An early Ice/Dragon attacker.
